simple: Protection from external digital risks (Digital Risk Protection, formerly IntSights). Monitors the open, deep and dark web — hacker forums, closed channels, black markets — for threats to the company, its employees and customers; Rapid7 analysts work inside closed communities and can engage with attackers. Finds phishing sites and domains, fake social media pages and counterfeit mobile apps, and leaks of code, confidential data and passwords on Pastebin, GitHub and other sites — and files takedown requests, tracking them through to completion. Builds a map of the company’s digital assets to match threats specifically to it; includes management of indicators of compromise (IOC) with enrichment, a threat library and integrations for automatic blocking.
